fusions.name: Reef Rash
fusions.desc: Bites with your weapon for 7 water damage, making the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Run Aground
fusions.desc: Drives through a cone 3 tiles ahead and deals 12 water damage, leaving every enemy hit [Stunned] for 1 second and [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Growing Shelter
fusions.desc: Grows a reef where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles of it, and it grows 10% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Polyp by Polyp
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
